messages:
alex: quick flag 1 1 we're seeing inconsistent batch negotiation across SDKs. Some libs send `X-RW-Batch: envelope` header, others still use `?batch=1` or `batch_mode` query. This breaks streaming deserializers.
priya: which endpoints? generation / streaming / embeddings?
alex: streaming generation primarily. Enveloped requests work fine for non-streaming. Streaming clients choke if we wrap frames.
tom: could we do content sniffing at ingress? check first byte/line and decide if envelope or raw stream. Cheap enough?
chen: sniffing works but edge TLS proxy likes to coalesce frames; we saw false positives. Also increases CPU on edge.
priya: proposal: support both shapes for a transition window, reply with `Warning` header when we detect legacy query param, and emit `compat_mode=legacy` tag in logs. Add opt-in strictness via `x-rw-compat: strict` so newer SDKs can opt into enforcement early.
alex: rough pseudo-code I sketched:

```
// ingress negotiation
if req.headers["x-rw-compat"] == "strict":
  enforce_envelope(req)
elif req.query.get("batch") == "1" or req.headers.get("x-rw-batch") == "legacy":
  route_to_legacy_unwrap(req)
else:
  forward_as_new(req)
```

chen: routing to a legacy unwrap path avoids touching the hot streaming path. That path can be a lightweight sidecar/unwrapper that only peeks prefix. Downside: extra hop and bookkeeping for tenant mapping.
tom: sidecar ops cost + latency. Alternative: an nginx lua filter that only peeks first 256 bytes and sets a header. Lower ops footprint.
priya: telemetry: we need counts (legacy vs new), per-tenant error rates, and median latency delta. Metric name: `compat_shim.requests_total` with tags `mode:(legacy|new)`, `tenant`, `endpoint`. Dashboards & alert when legacy > 10% for 14 days.
chen: perf bench (local): naive in-process unwrap = +2.1ms p50, +9ms p99 under 1000rps. Lua-peek approach = +0.4ms p50, +1.2ms p99. Sidecar adds ~7-12ms tail depending on data center hops.
alex: rollout idea: 1) accept both, add Warning header + telemetry for 8 weeks. 2) enable `x-rw-compat: strict` opt-in for beta tenants. 3) after 70% adoption and low error rate, announce deprecation and 60-day notice.
priya: owners: ingress work = eng-infra (chen), runtime streaming handling = eng-runtime (tom), SDK updates = devex (alex). I'll own metrics/dashboards.
ops-bot: scheduled: deploy ingress-lua-peek canary to staging on 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z (ticket ARCH-8821)
alex: I'll write a short RFC with example requests/responses, error codes (422 for incompatible frames, 299 Warning for legacy), and migration steps for SDK teams.
priya: also add migration kit: client example patches and test harness to simulate mixed traffic.
chen: perf tests will be in infra/benchmarks repo, I'll paste numbers before EOW.
tom: +1. Meeting tomorrow 11am PT to finalize decisions. /remind #architecture tomorrow 11am finalize negotiation design :spiral_calendar:
